lead.headline: A third of small, non-exempt US-listed foreign companies missed a new March 2026 insider-stock deadline by 13+ days
lead.number: China/HK small issuers trail other small foreign issuers by 12 points, not 16, once blank-country firms are placed; vs non-Israel peers p = 0.08, vs Asian/US/Australian peers p = 0.53.
lead.watch_out: DERA leaves the business-country field blank on ~40% of late-2025 rows, which misfiled 26 China/HK firms as "other"; what's left of the China gap depends on one peer country, Israel.

sources.outlet: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Division of Corporation Finance
sources.quote: In light of the unusually large number of Form ID applications submitted as a result of the HFIA Act, the staff will not recommend enforcement action

The effective extensions available require that the FPI director or officer without EDGAR access on March 18, 2026 file the required Section 16(a) report after receiving EDGAR access but in no event later than April 1, 2026.
The qualifying jurisdictions listed in the order are Canada, Chile, the European Economic Area (EEA), the Republic of Korea, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.

sources.outlet: Troutman Pepper Locke (law firm client alert)
sources.quote: While statements from the legislation’s sponsors clearly show the legislative intention is directed primarily at Chinese companies, it will remain to be seen how the law will impact companies that operate in jurisdictions with similar reporting requirements.
